preconditions.description: Number of water tanks is between 2 and 50.
Total increase in pipe widths is between 0 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= cij <= 10**6 for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each pipe width is between 0 and 10^6.
There are no pipes from a tank to itself.

postconditions.description: The maximum amount of water that can be transmitted is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: return_value <= sum(cij for i in range(n) for j in range(n)) + k
postconditions.description: The maximum amount of water does not exceed the total possible width after increasing by k.
